cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the full body, hips, knees, ankles, and toes visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep the chest lifted with no more than 45 degrees of forward lean.
metrics.hint_good: Your chest stayed controlled through the squat.
metrics.hint_high: Your body folded too far forward. Lift your chest and brace your core.

metrics.targetText: Keep a balanced foot position while the knees follow the toes.
metrics.hint_good: Your knee position stayed balanced over the feet.
metrics.hint_low: Your knees stayed too far back. Let them bend naturally as the hips lower.
metrics.hint_high: Your knees travelled too far forward. Sit the hips back slightly and keep the heels grounded.

metrics.targetText: Lower the hips to around knee level while staying controlled.
metrics.hint_good: You reached a useful squat depth.
metrics.hint_low: You lowered very deep. Use a slightly smaller range if control starts to change.
metrics.hint_high: The squat was shallow. Lower the hips a little more while keeping the heels down.

metrics.targetText: Return to a tall position with the knees nearly straight.
metrics.hint_good: You returned to a clear standing position.
metrics.hint_low: Stand a little taller before starting the next squat.
metrics.hint_high: Stand tall without forcing the knees backward.

metrics.targetText: Reach a similar bottom position on each squat.
metrics.hint_good: Your squats reached a similar depth.
metrics.hint_high: The squat depth changed between movements. Choose one range you can repeat.

metrics.targetText: Keep a similar chest angle on each squat.
metrics.hint_high: Your chest position changed between squats. Brace before each movement.
